gems.note: In Midnight both rings and the neck always come with a socket, and additional sockets cannot be added to them. You can, however, add sockets to your Helm Bracers Belt The item for this is called Radiant Jewelbinder and can be purchased from the vendor next to the Great Vault in Silvermoon. This results in six total gem slots, or seven if you use Eye Of Midnight , which has two sockets. Your neck can be fitted with a unique gem. Telluric Eversong Diamond is the default choice, as it helps you with your mana in longer encounters. If mana is not a concern, Powerful Eversong Diamond becomes the stronger alternative. To maximize the effect of these unique gems, you should equip four different gem colors. Use Flawless Versatile Garnet (Red) Flawless Quick Amethyst (Purple) Flawless Masterful Lapis (Blue) Flawless Masterful Peridot (Green). Once you have one of each colour equipped, fill any remaining sockets with Flawless Quick Amethyst for the best value.
